Karnataka Minister Denies Using KRIDL for Development Work

Karnataka Minister U.T. Khader stated that the Karnataka Rural Infrastructure Development Limited (KRIDL) did not execute any development work in his Mangaluru Assembly constituency. He claimed that KRIDL does not float tenders for such projects but is instead preferred by elected representatives. Khader asserted that he deliberately kept KRIDL out of his constituency.
